title: Add 0.2.3 release notes entry to CHANGELOG
body:
Prepares changelog content for the confirmed formal `v0.2.3` release by adding the missing topmost release section in the required position and format, without touching version files or other project artifacts.

- **Changelog update**
  - Inserted a new `0.2.3` section in `CHANGELOG.md` immediately after the introductory format paragraph and before `0.2.2`.
  - Kept all existing entries and structure unchanged.

- **Release notes content (exact)**
  - Added the provided date and text:
    - `## [0.2.3] — 2026-09-23`
    - `**文档与版本信息更新。**`
    - `### Changed` with three bullets for version/README updates.

```markdown
## [0.2.3] — 2026-09-23

**文档与版本信息更新。**

### Changed

- 更新项目版本至 `0.2.3`。
- 更新中文 README。
- 更新 README。
```
